english.note: Use this as the technical noun for the height of a triangle in mathematics.

examples.english: The height of a triangle is the line segment dropped perpendicularly from a vertex to the opposite side.
examples.traditional: 三角形嘅高係由頂點垂直落到對面條邊嘅線段。
